title: Build an Offline Bookmark Outbox
prompt: Implement optimistic bookmark state, durable outbox, idempotent sync, coalescing, authentication pause, conflict versions, rejection recovery, and two-device convergence tests.
successCriteria: Process death never loses accepted intent.
Duplicate delivery has one logical effect.
Every conflict and permanent rejection has a visible resolution.
hints: Name the authoritative state and durable identity before selecting a library API.
Test the operation after cancellation, duplication, or process recreation.

starterCode.code: class BookmarkOutboxRepository(private val db: NewsDatabase, private val remote: BookmarkRemote)

solutionOutline: Model the data, operation, failure, and recovery states explicitly.
Implement the transactional path and prove every adverse success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic persistence or protocol tests.
Inspect durable state after interruption and retry.
